jobs.task: Resume the failed evaluation branch in Research / Q4 without losing the decision record.
jobs.completion: The branch, its last failure, and its parent are visible together.

jobs.task: Compare the failed branch with a measurement branch in another space and open the report they share.
jobs.completion: Both outcomes and the exact shared report revision are visible.

entities.label: Space
entities.description: Nested workspace with a stable ID and an inherited permission boundary.

entities.label: Conversation
entities.description: Canonical content and status owned by one space, possibly referenced in others.

entities.label: Task branch
entities.description: Owns a base conversation revision and independent run states.

entities.label: Artifact revision
entities.description: Immutable result with provenance. Access may be withheld in the current space.

states.description: Spaces are collapsed to bounded clusters with branch state counts.
One object is selected with its path, immediate edges and focusable relation table.
Two branches are pinned by ID with aligned provenance and independent statuses.
The reference and its reason are visible. Private payloads are withheld.
A distinct run attempt is in progress while the original failure remains inspectable.

transitions.effect: Expand by scope and keep breadcrumbs and focus anchor.
Record the prior selection and move focus to related object.
Compare by base revision and shared artifact IDs.
Show reason and retain comparison and focus anchor.
Restore comparison without revealing private content.
Create a new attempt on the same branch with a new run ID.
Restore previous cluster expansion and focus.

alternatives.name: Scope atlas
alternatives.model: Hierarchical graph with selectable spaces, branches and artifacts.
alternatives.navigation: From cluster → failure → cross-space dependency. Relation table offers equivalent keyboard actions.
alternatives.hardCase: Expand Research / Q4, focus Eval B, pin it, traverse the uses-report edge, pin Baseline C and open report v3 in compare.
alternatives.tradeoff: Compact for dependencies and deep spaces. High fan-out needs edge aggregation and progressive disclosure.

alternatives.name: Execution lanes
alternatives.model: Time-aligned branch lanes and run attempts around a pinned checkpoint.
alternatives.navigation: Select a time window, align lanes by base revision, then expand artifacts at a checkpoint.
alternatives.hardCase: Filter failed attempts, anchor Eval B at 14:02, open the sibling lane and align Baseline C on report v3 rather than wall time.
alternatives.tradeoff: Good for retries and chronology. A long-lived artifact spanning windows needs a pinned checkpoint and explicit time reset.

alternatives.name: Evidence index
alternatives.model: Artifact revisions are the primary objects. Conversations appear as linked citations.
alternatives.navigation: Search exact revision ID or a semantic facet, pivot between producers and consumers, then open a branch in context.
alternatives.hardCase: Search the incident label, select report v3, inspect failing consumer Eval B beside producing Baseline C, then reopen the original decision record.
alternatives.tradeoff: Direct for provenance, slower when users know the branch and have no artifact reference yet.
